concepts.proposed_markdown: The defining-structure guide adds that each payment-processing legal entity needs at least one merchant account, a merchant account cannot span two legal entities, and each merchant account has one acquiring region. It links the merchant account to the legal entity owning the ultimate settlement bank account and permits only one bank account per settlement currency. These are Adyen account/settlement configuration rules in a dated guide; they do not determine the merchant of record or full funds flow. [[source-adyen-docs-account-define-account-structure]]
warnings: Keep this rule scoped to the 2019-last-modified Adyen account-structure guide; no current eligibility or MOR determination follows.
